purpose: Independent held-out component cases for spec26 ticket34 endpoint evaluation

label_meanings.complete: The presented text forms a complete request or question.
label_meanings.needhold: The presented prefix is linguistically incomplete; preserve it for continuation.
label_meanings.cannotinfer: The presented prefix is already plausible as a complete turn. Future continuation cannot be established from text alone; do not score the model as if it can predict future speech.

evaluation_limits: Text-only authoring does not establish prosody or physical endpoint accuracy.
Pauses and segmentation are synthetic scenario definitions, not measured recordings.
Freeze cases and labels before candidate inference. Keep this set separate from prompt or threshold tuning.
Report cannotinfer cases separately from clear completeness errors. A product grace policy may preserve their continuation without implying semantic prediction.
